name: Claude-Red
description: claude-red is a curated library of offensive security skills designed for the Claude skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md file that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface — from SQLi to shellcode, EDR evasion to exploit development.
one_liner: A library of cheat-sheets that teaches an AI assistant to work through offensive-security methodology the way a professional penetration tester would, across attack surfaces from web apps to exploit development.
buyer: A licensed penetration-testing or red-team consultancy that wants to speed up its testers' work on already-authorized client engagements.
business_use_cases: A pentest firm uses it to accelerate the recon and exploitation phases of signed, authorized client engagements, improving margins on fixed-price contracts.
A security-training company builds an 'ethical hacking with AI' course around it for aspiring pentesters.
An internal red team at a large company uses it to run more frequent authorized internal assessments.

money_ideas.idea: Sell training/certification content built around it for licensed security professionals
Package it into an internal 'AI red-team co-pilot' used only on the firm's own authorized engagements

steal_this: Honest take: this is only legitimately useful inside signed, authorized engagements. The realistic weekend build is a training workshop for already-licensed testers, not a general product — the addressable market is narrow and the tool's dual-use nature limits how it can be commercialized responsibly.
